parts_lists.structure: Item number in left column, description, part numbers, quantity columns (NO OFF), repair grades (L/M/H)
parts_lists.characteristics: Dense text tables, organized by item number matching callout numbers

key_insight.statement: The RPS is NOT random or size-determined. It follows a STRUCTURED PATTERN:
pattern: 1. Front matter (pages 1-9): Cover, contents, preface, instructions
2. Indices (pages 10-20+): NIIN to GROUP code cross-reference
3. Group sections (pages ~21-927): For EACH OF 31 GROUPS:
a. Illustration page(s) with numbered callouts (visual assembly)
b. Parts list page(s) with matching item numbers (text details)
4. Back matter (pages 928-930): Final index, back cover

groups_identified.all_31_groups: A, AA, AAA, AB, ABA, ABB, AC, ACB, AD, AE, AF, BA, BB, BC, BD, BDA, BE, BFA, BFB, ... FDA, FDB, FDE, FBD, ED, HA, J, JA, JB, EC, DHA, DHB, DK

barry_implications.illustration_pages: Can show visual assembly with numbered callouts - Barry highlights the specific callout number for requested part
barry_implications.parts_list_pages: Shows full item description, NSN, part numbers, quantities - Barry returns complete part details
barry_implications.paired_structure: Each group has illustration+parts list pair - Barry can show BOTH visual and text together as 'package'
